instruction: Inspect evidence.json and write classification.json. The output must contain exactly schema_version and endpoints. schema_version must be 1. endpoints must be an object keyed by every exact endpoint id e01 through e12. Each endpoint value must contain exactly class, evidence_refs, and next_action. class must be one of CONFIRMED_ANONYMOUS, PREAUTH_BOOTSTRAP, ANONYMOUS_READ_CANDIDATE, SESSION_BOUND, UNKNOWN. evidence_refs must be a non-empty array of RFC 6901 JSON pointers into evidence.json without duplicates, written as evidence.json#<pointer>. next_action must be one of NONE, BOUNDED_ANONYMOUS_PROBE, AUTH_BOUNDARY, RECOVER_MORE_CONTEXT. Use only observable evidence. Do not infer anonymous server access merely because no endpoint-specific auth annotation or session guard was observed. Classification and evidence rules: (1) CONFIRMED_ANONYMOUS: requires successful live anonymous probe (next_action: NONE; evidence_refs must include /live_probe/application_success and /live_probe/no_token). (2) PREAUTH_BOOTSTRAP: endpoint reachable before session as part of bootstrap/login (next_action: AUTH_BOUNDARY if requesting credentials/login, BOUNDED_ANONYMOUS_PROBE for configuration; evidence_refs must include /reachable_before_session and either /call_context or /request_fields). (3) ANONYMOUS_READ_CANDIDATE: read-only endpoint without observed session guard lacking live qualification (next_action: BOUNDED_ANONYMOUS_PROBE; evidence_refs must include /session_guard_observed, /remote_mutation, and /live_probe/attempted). (4) SESSION_BOUND: observable session guard or account-bound mutation (next_action: AUTH_BOUNDARY; evidence_refs must include /session_guard_observed and either /remote_mutation or /reachable_before_session). (5) UNKNOWN: conflicting or insufficient evidence (next_action: RECOVER_MORE_CONTEXT; evidence_refs must include /conflicting_evidence). Do not modify fixture files.
